about_the_game:
Welcome to Suds!

This is a fun game about teamwork, strategy, and very cute heroes. You play as a Sud, a brave little creature protecting your home.

Your village is a cool place with big mushrooms and flowers, but enemy slimes are attacking. Only you and your friends can stop them. But be careful, there is a secret...

--- Game Modes ---

We have several modes for you to try, for both multiplayer and single-player.

  • Endless Mode (Multiplayer): Fight waves of enemy slimes that never stop. Your job is simple: survive! The enemies get stronger, so you must work together and use your skills well. When one teammate is defeated, the game ends. The Sud with the highest score is the winner.

  • Last Standing Mode (Multiplayer): The goal is the same: protect the village. But here, only one thing matters: being the last Sud alive. Points don't count. You still need your team to survive for longer!

  • Infection Mode (Multiplayer): This is a real test! One of your teammates gets infected by the enemy slimes. Your mission is to save your friend while you fight the other slimes. Be very careful – you must not kill your infected teammate! Your team wins if you survive all 20 waves. You lose if your infected friend is killed, or if all of you get infected.

  • Corrida Mode (Single-player): It's you against one big, infected slime boss! In this mode, you must be clever, like in a bullfight. Dodge its attacks and trick the slime into using its own power against itself. This is great practice to prepare you for saving your friends in Infection Mode.

--- More Features ---

  • Offline Quests: If you want to play alone, there is a single-player mode with lots of quests. You'll meet new enemies and face different challenges. It's a great way to improve your skills and explore the world of Suds on your own.

  • Power-ups and Secrets: There are special power-ups hidden in the game to help you. What do they do? That’s a secret for you to discover! Play the game, find them, and use their power to protect your village.

ext_user_account_notice: To participate in our game's online multiplayer matchmaking, players must register for an account within the game. While we require all users to register, we do not require the use of a real email address during the registration process. However, we do encourage users to provide a valid email address in order to receive important updates and news about the game. Please note that without a registered account, players will not be able to participate in the online multiplayer features of the game.

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Dual-core, 64-bit Intel or AMD CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or later compatible video card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 440.62 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: The game may run on lower-end systems but may require lowering graphics settings.
